title: The tax agency wants “verification”
scenario: A letter-looking email says your identity must be verified before your tax return can be processed. It links to a page asking for a selfie, ID and full bank account number.

answers.A: Go to the tax authority’s official site yourself and check whether an identity-verification notice exists in your account.
answers.B: Call the tax authority using a published number and ask what documents are legitimately required.
answers.C: Upload the ID and selfie first but wait to enter the bank details until you receive confirmation.

explanation: Government identity checks can be real, which is why the channel matters. Verify the notice before sending a complete identity bundle.
proTip: Sensitive documents belong in a verified government process, not an email link.
